motion.name: state-feedback
motion.purpose: Control color feedback and disclosure chevron rotation; removed for reduced motion.

motion.name: notebook-addition
motion.purpose: New source quotes fade from Harbor to white once; the New badge and border remain. No animation for reduced motion.

motion.name: history-panel
motion.purpose: Interruptible history slide and desktop content translation, with a fading mobile backdrop. Keyboard toggles are immediate; reduced motion uses a 160ms fade only.

motion.name: milo-expression
motion.purpose: Crossfade mouth opacity and transition tile background on saved-state changes only; no loop; disabled for reduced motion.

studentPersona.scope: Local restoration of the session header avatar; production layout preserved.

expressions.celebrating: full-score exam at the current fresh notebook revision

studentPersona.semantics: Acknowledges saved progress, not correctness or measured understanding. Drafts and duplicate quotes do not advance the expression. API pauses preserve it.
studentPersona.accessibility: Decorative SVG is aria-hidden. Visible AI label and role=status text remain.

learningFeedback.scope: Restore morning features 3, 4 and 5; preserve the current homepage and workspace layout.
learningFeedback.notebook: Stable source-plus-quote keys; new entries arrive over 200ms, stagger capped at 160ms; original message in a native From your explanation disclosure. Reduced motion removes arrival/highlight animation.
learningFeedback.exam: Only a new saved attempt opens the skippable question walkthrough. Reload/stale results open in full. Focus follows headings; explain-question action preserves the composer draft. No model calls for review.
learningFeedback.improvement: Existing detailed comparison plus score arrow and Sea Green acknowledgement. One 280ms checkmark animation for a newly completed, comparable positive change; 140ms fade for reduced motion. No celebration on replay, regression or changed questions.

components.css: .ds-topic{font-family: Manrope, "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; line-height: 1.6;border:1px solid #a4afb7;border-radius:16px;background:var(--paper,#f6f2ef);color:var(--ink,#363e4f);}.ds-topic summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding:18px 20px;min-height:80px;cursor:pointer;list-style:none;border-radius:16px;font-size:17px;font-weight:600;}.ds-topic summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none;}.ds-topic summary svg{flex-shrink:0;transition:transform 160ms ease-out;}.ds-topic[open] summary{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#d2d7da);border-radius:16px 16px 0 0;}.ds-topic[open] summary svg{transform:rotate(180deg);}.ds-topic-menu{padding:8px;}.ds-topic-option{font-family: Manrope, "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; line-height: 1.6;width:100%;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:12px;min-height:68px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:var(--harbor,#b0c8cc);color:var(--ink,#363e4f);text-align:left;cursor:pointer;}.ds-topic-option strong{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;}.ds-topic-option small{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#40545d;margin-top:4px;}.ds-topic summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #396b7a); outline-offset: 4px; }.ds-topic-option:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #396b7a); outline-offset: 4px; }@media(hover:hover){.ds-topic summary:hover{background:var(--wash,#e9edef);}.ds-topic-option:hover{background:var(--harbor,#b0c8cc);}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-topic summary svg{transition:none;}}

narrative.overview:
A calm teaching workspace built from Pearl canvas, Harbor navigation and rounded task surfaces. Midnight gives headings, actions and user messages a consistent anchor; Sea Green progress and Santorini notebook panels separate supporting work.

Manrope keeps the invitation, controls and conversation in one voice. Depth comes from adjacent color fields and fine borders, with compact metadata and generous task spacing. This record replaces the retired account-entry system and describes the current workspace only.
keyCharacteristics: Five supplied colors with explicit readable companion inks
Rounded task panels and native disclosure controls
Flat tonal depth and restrained state feedback

rules.name: The Readable Surface Rule
rules.body: Use Harbor ink on Harbor supporting text and Green ink on Sea Green text; the general muted ink belongs on the light neutral surfaces.

rules.name: The One Typeface Rule
rules.body: Use the bundled Manrope for headings, body and controls; hierarchy comes from size, weight and spacing.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Separate workspace regions with surface colors and fine borders; the shipped workspace has no box shadows.

dos: Do preserve the five supplied palette roles and their surface-specific text colors.
Do keep visible focus, text status labels and SVG state indicators alongside color.
Do stack task columns and use the modal history drawer at the implemented narrow breakpoints.
Do use sentence case, rounded panels and the bundled Manrope.
donts: Don't reintroduce the retired charcoal/pink authentication identity into the workspace.
Don't substitute a system display face for Manrope.
Don't treat synthesized sidecar tonal ramps as additional approved application tokens.
